name: reset-by-shruti-funnel
//browserslist: Stops Next shipping polyfills for Array.at / flat / flatMap / Object.fromEntries / Object.hasOwn / trimStart / trimEnd (~26 KB of dead weight plus parse time on a phone). These floors are not a new restriction: globals.css already leans on color-mix(), :has() and text-wrap, so the site never rendered correctly below them anyway. This aligns the JS target with the CSS that was already shipping.
